scope: Fixed-source public GameSession route comparison for optional finite far-side reinforcement sources. No browser, GPU performance, state injection, human fun or multi-objective balance claim.

reuse.publicPolicyBoundary: Reuse v088 normal navigation, visible frozen-danger avoidance, repair thresholds, dash/E/Q handling, offered protocol/replacement transaction handling, and growth priorities. No immune-only withholding of ordinary fire; catalysis/unknown growth IDs remain excluded.
reuse.baseline: Existing v088 three-seed normal-strategy records may be descriptively truncated at wave16; no baseline rerun is required and unlike source routes they have no eight-second source preview. Do not imply a fixed-state causal experiment.

shared: Normal main/immune input runs on a shallow read-only policy view excluding source bodies from intentional target ranking. The actual GameSession world and automatic cells/protocols are untouched.
Both routes preserve the existing repair decision: tissue<72, or player<55% maximum while tissue<99. Both preserve already frozen danger escape and imminent dash decisions ahead of route pursuit.
All choices are actual offered public choices; route-caused XP/sample/gear differences remain part of the route outcome rather than being normalized by injected equipment.
routePolicies.near: Never intentionally walk toward or aim at a source. Continue the ordinary close-threat/repair policy during warning and combat. Incidental source damage or kills from real cells, chains or area attacks are allowed and explicitly recorded, not hidden or prevented.
routePolicies.rush: After the actual source announcement, move toward its frozen published point during warning. In combat prioritize that live source, with the shared repair/danger overrides. Keep the original build standoff distances (shooting320, immune240), tool readiness, Q and normal path navigation. Do not fire/scan at an unborn body. Return to the shared ordinary policy when destroyed/exhausted/unavailable.
routePolicies.sourceKnowledge: Only actual ENDLESS_SOURCE_ANNOUNCED receipts and public source/body state are used. No future source-plan access before announcement.

measurements: Per-source announced position, compass bearing, tissue distance, player position/distance at announcement/birth/first accepted HP loss/destruction/exhaustion/clear, and exact warning duration.

Actual player travel split into warning and combat, time and travel to first source hit, public intent switches repair/dodge/source/ordinary, and time/distance spent away from tissue. Prepositioning during otherwise quiet warnings must remain visible.
Source maxHP and actual positive HP-loss receipts by tool/ability/protocol/physical immune root; first hit, actual death versus natural quota exhaustion, and source kill credit are distinct.

Quota slot IDs from the existing schedule, actual born actor IDs/slot receipts, actual canceled future slots, fallback births, total scheduled birth/cancel/remaining conservation, and support/elite role slots unaffected by cancellation.

Non-source living bodies and pending fission promises at cutoff; later real death/child-birth receipts or surviving IDs account for them. Legal subsequent attacks may kill them; absence without real accounting is flagged. No forced child survival is required.

Every wave's warning/combat duration, peak live/reserved population and commitments, actual player damage, enemy tissue damage, protocol/environment tissue cost, repairs, XP/sample reward receipts, upgrade choices and final result.
Input prefix before first source announcement must be identical for matched seed/build routes. Later policies, inputs, births, XP/equipment and state may diverge naturally.
Actual cell contribution uses positive TARGET_HIT protocolId IMMUNE_BEACON with a real cell/:bite root and matching tick, deduplicated by tick/root/target; log plans and Q requests are not damage.
mechanicalAcceptance: Every executed simulation source is frozen and hashed before the first run and remains unchanged afterward. Exactly12 fixed independent cases and one predetermined replay; every defeat/stall/error remains in output.

Only public start/step/chooseDraft/chooseCombatUpgrade/cancelResearch/resume, with offered replacement confirmation. No HP, position, time, enemies, wave, source status, quota or equipment-state assignment.

Actual source birth cannot precede its eight-second announcement. A source uses one existing ordinary slot, and canceled slots are an exact not-yet-born subset of its finite ordinary quota; no support/elite slot cancellation and no double source/cancel/clear receipt.

At completed public-step boundaries, all scheduled ordinal slots are still queued, actually born, or explicitly canceled exactly once. Caps remain live/reserved<=24, fission parents<=4 and commitments<=3. Exhaustion changes source status, not fake TARGET_CLEARED/XP/kill credit.

Every witnessed existing body or fission promise at source cutoff remains present or is later accounted for by legitimate clear/child-birth receipts; quota cancellation never silently erases it. Unobserved branches remain unobserved.
Candidate71 immune rush replay must match its full original raw JSON bytes; no replacement or extra seed.
routeInterpretation: Report per-source and whole-run paired time, combat/warning travel, actual canceled quota, player/organ loss/cost, repair burden and rewards. Keep all six seed/build pairs and all36 expected independent source encounters visible.

A short choice window is exposed if a source exhausts/can no longer cancel before the near route could reach/attack it through normal navigation, or rush must arrive fully during warning to cancel any quota. Do not lengthen the measurement or secretly stop enemy births to make coverage.

Pre-register a dominance warning: rush is weakly no worse in total simulated wave duration (within one fixed tick), actual player loss and total organ loss including player costs across all matched source waves, and strictly better in at least one objective for each seed/build pair. This flags the measured objective set only, not universal optimality or fun.

Separately report zero-risk prepositioning when rush covers the required approach during warning and first hits the source within0.5s of its birth. A planned8s preview is not counted as combat travel or a newly earned safety window.

Route existence or early-cancel utility is not enough to claim balanced multi-objective decision making. Any counterexample, incidental near-route clear, all-cancel rush, unexploitable window, route dominance or real defeat is retained.
